The '''bloodflower''' was a type of flower native to [[Grella]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|The Bloodflowers}}</ref>

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the flower bloomed on [[Grella]], marking the first time an individual had seen the flower bloom since the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="Mission" />

==Behind the scenes==
Prior to Game Update 4.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', the Bioanalysis crew skill mission "The Bloodflowers" was only available to Imperial characters. Additionally, the mission text stated that the bloodflower grew on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].
